backend: Zylin original Java simulator (not Questa, team C++ simulator or team RTL)
limitations: Tier 0 only; no native-vs-emulated trace matching is attempted
RAM is zero initialized, 32 KiB; initial SP 0x7ff8; no interrupts or devices
Instruction fetch budget and host wall-clock timeout are distinct
Adapter invokes a private loop in the pinned upstream simulator; other JAR versions are rejected
